title: SCOOP: Godzilla Minus Zero's India release likely to be PUSHED to November 20 due to Ramayana's two-week IMAX exclusivity
raw_summary:
Bollywood Hungama has been at the forefront of reporting developments surrounding Godzilla Minus Zero. Last month, we spoke exclusively to Kamal Gianchandani, Chief Business Planning & Strategy at PVR INOX Limited and CEO of PVR INOX Pictures Limited, who confirmed that the much-awaited film would release in India. Earlier this month, we informed readers that Godzilla Minus Zero was expected to release in India in the same week as the rest of the world, on November 6. However, there has now been a change of plans.

Yesterday, October 27, the social media handle of PVR INOX Pictures shared the poster of Godzilla Minus Zero. This marks the first official communication from the distribution company confirming that the film will indeed be released in India. Moreover, the poster mentions 'Filmed for IMAX', hinting that the film will also get an IMAX release in the country. However, the exact release date is yet to be announced. The poster simply mentions 'Only in theatres this November'.

 

View this post on Instagram

  A post shared by PVRINOX Pictures (@pvrpictures)

A trade source told Bollywood Hungama, "Godzilla Minus Zero is a film made for IMAX. So is Ramayana. Ramayana is a local film and has a two-week exclusivity window on IMAX screens in India. Hence, if PVR INOX has mentioned IMAX on the poster and in the caption of its social media post, one can assume that Godzilla Minus Zero will most likely release in India two weeks later, on November 20 as Ramayana arrives on the big screen on November 5. However, they are still discussing whether they can release the film on November 20 or somehow bring the film to cinemas on November 13. An official announcement should arrive soon."

Bollywood Hungama had earlier reported that Godzilla Minus Zero would get limited showcasing in India's IMAX properties. This means that at most IMAX cinemas, it is likely to get just one show, while the remaining shows will be allotted to Ramayana. When asked about this, the trade source replied, "Yes, that's what is expected to happen, though a final call will be taken closer to the release."

Nevertheless, fans are overjoyed with the announcement by PVR INOX Pictures. The source remarked, "For almost two weeks, fans in India were speculating whether Godzilla Minus Zero would even release in India. As a result, this update was much needed."

Meanwhile, an industry insider pointed out, "The Hunger Games: Sunrise On The Reaping is also scheduled for release on November 20. This is also an IMAX film and is expected to release in the premium format in India. Moreover, Ramayana will be running very successfully in its third week, if all goes well. So, it'll be a challenge to divide shows between these three films in the third week of November, should The Hunger Games: Sunrise On The Reaping also release in IMAX."

title: Vardhaan Puri to star in Param Veer, a film based on the 1971 Battle of Gangasagar
raw_summary:
Vardhaan Puri will headline Param Veer, an upcoming film set during the 1971 Indo-Pakistan War. The film’s title and poster have been unveiled, introducing a project centred on the Battle of Gangasagar and the soldiers who fought in it. The film is produced and directed by Sumant Raturi, with Sagar Gowda serving as co-producer. It is being backed by HVJ Media and Myradha Motion Pictures. Further details about the cast, storyline and release date have not yet been announced.

Speaking about his association with the project, Vardhaan said the film had become a personal experience over the past year and had deepened his appreciation for the sacrifices made by members of the armed forces and their families. “Being a part of the film Param Veer has been an experience that has touched, moved, and inspired me in ways I could never have imagined. What began as a film has, over the past year, become a deeply personal and transformative journey,” the actor said.

He added that working on a story centred on soldiers had strengthened his respect for their service and the sacrifices made by their families. “Working on this film has given me a profound sense of gratitude and an even greater respect for our soldiers and their families, who make extraordinary sacrifices for our nation,” Vardhaan said.

 

View this post on Instagram

  A post shared by HVJ Media (@hvjmedia)

Vardhaan Puri on the Battle of Gangasagar The actor also acknowledged director Sumant Raturi’s approach to the project and the team's work on bringing the historical subject to the screen. “Sumant Sir’s vision, along with the love and conviction with which the entire team has brought this story to life, makes this film incredibly special. I am truly excited for the audiences to experience the film and the spirit behind the film,” he said.

Reflecting on the significance of the Battle of Gangasagar, Vardhaan described the film as an opportunity to revisit the experiences of soldiers whose contributions deserve to be remembered. “The legend of The Battle of Gangasagar is not just a story from our history; it is a tribute to the bravehearts who shaped it, and a reminder that behind every soldier’s sacrifice are countless stories of courage, love, and dedication that deserve to be remembered,” he added.

With Param Veer, Vardhaan takes on a project rooted in India's military history. The makers are yet to share further information about his character, the rest of the cast and the film's theatrical release.

title: Imran Khan gets interim relief as Bombay High Court puts FRRO’s ‘Leave India Notice’ on hold till November 2
raw_summary:
The Bombay High Court on Tuesday put on hold a notice issued by the Foreigners Regional Registration Office (FRRO) directing actor Imran Khan to leave India by October 28. The court’s order will remain in effect until November 2, when the matter is scheduled to be heard again.

A Division Bench comprising Chief Justice Mahesh Chandra Tripathi and Justice Advait Sethna passed the direction after the Central government sought more time to respond to Khan’s petition. The Centre’s counsel also assured the court that no coercive action would be taken against the actor in the interim.

During the hearing, the Additional Solicitor General (ASG), representing the Centre, requested that the matter be listed on Monday, November 2. Senior Advocate Venkatesh Dhond, appearing for Khan, pointed out that the actor had been directed to leave India the following day under the FRRO notice.

The ASG subsequently assured the bench that no action would be taken against Khan before the next hearing. The court then adjourned the matter and ordered that the challenged FRRO directive remain suspended until the next hearing. Why Imran Khan approached the Bombay High Court Khan filed his petition on October 17, seeking to quash the FRRO’s October 14 “Leave India Notice”. He also sought interim protection against deportation, lookout notices and interference with his Overseas Citizen of India (OCI) status.

The notice followed Khan’s brief detention by the police after he participated in protests against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. A complaint was also filed by BJP leader Kirit Somaiya over alleged public-order violations.

In his petition, Khan argued that the FRRO issued the notice because he had attempted to attend the protest. He alleged that the authorities acted hastily and without giving him a prior hearing, claiming that political pressure and social media campaigns had influenced the decision.

Khan further contended that the authorities had bypassed the safeguards provided under Section 7D of the Citizenship Act, which governs the cancellation of OCI registration. Separate notice issued over OCI status On October 17, the FRRO also issued a show-cause notice under Section 7D concerning the possible cancellation of Khan’s OCI status. However, this separate notice has not been challenged in the current petition, according to the details of the case.

Khan has also asked the court to direct the authorities to produce internal records relating to the decision to issue the notice.

The matter is scheduled to be heard again on November 2 at 3 pm. Until then, the FRRO’s direction requiring Khan to leave India remains on hold.

title: Gondhal trailer out: Santosh Davakhar’s Oscar-submitted film to release in seven languages on November 13, 2026
raw_summary:
The global trailer of Gondhal, directed by Santosh Davakhar, has been released ahead of the film’s worldwide theatrical release on November 13, 2026. The psychological thriller, which is India’s official submission for the 99th Academy Awards in the Best International Feature Film category, will release in seven languages: Hindi, Marathi, Tamil, Telugu, Malayalam, Kannada and English.

According to the makers, the multilingual release will cover markets including India, the US, the UK, Europe, Australia, Dubai and Africa. The film’s makers have described it as the first Marathi film to receive a seven-language global theatrical rollout.

Set against the cultural traditions of Maharashtra, Gondhal follows newlyweds Suman and Anandrao, whose lives take an unsettling turn as personal desires, marital responsibilities and devotion begin to intersect. The trailer offers glimpses of the couple’s strained circumstances and a series of mysterious events that form the basis of the psychological thriller. Santosh Davakhar on bringing Gondhal to a global audience Speaking about the film’s international reach, writer-director Santosh Davakhar said he wanted to introduce audiences to a lesser-seen aspect of Indian culture through the story.

“Global perceptions of Indian cinema are often shaped by narratives of poverty and caste conflict – important realities, but not the complete expression of India. Gondhal is not a film but generations of culture, people, traditions coming together. Getting the world to know about this tradition is something that makes me immensely happy,” he said.

 

View this post on Instagram

  A post shared by Gondhal (@gondhalfilm)

Davakhar also spoke about the role of international film platforms in bringing regional stories to audiences beyond their place of origin. “Global festivals like academy awards help filmmakers to bring forth the ethnicity of our very roots across continents and not only in India. To experience India in its truest form. I created this film to bring one such powerful tradition to the global screen through a culturally authentic and universal cinematic language,” he added. Gondhal’s Oscar journey and cast Gondhal has been selected as India’s official submission for the 99th Academy Awards in the Best International Feature Film category. The makers have also said the film is being considered in multiple categories, although further details about those submissions have not been specified.

Davakhar previously won the Silver Peacock for Best Director at the 56th International Film Festival of India (IFFI). The festival jury described Gondhal as “like a Shakespearean fable set in a real world.”

The film stars Ishita Deshmukh, Kishor Kadam, Yogesh Sohani and Nishad Bhoir. It is produced by Santosh Davakhar and Diksha Davakhar under the banner of Davakhar Films, with cinematography by Amalendu Chaudhary. The film opens with a 25-minute unbroken take, according to the makers.

Gondhal is scheduled to arrive in theatres worldwide on November 13, 2026.

title: Ganesh Acharya turns lyricist for the first time with ‘Kar Mehnat’, sung by Sonu Nigam
raw_summary:
Choreographer and filmmaker Ganesh Acharya has turned lyricist for the first time with ‘Kar Mehnat’, an inspirational song from his upcoming directorial venture Ganesh: Dust to Stardust. Sung by Sonu Nigam and composed by Junaid Kumar, the track focuses on hard work, perseverance and the determination to pursue one’s goals despite challenges.

The song comes ahead of the film’s theatrical release on December 11, 2026. Acharya, who has spent decades working across choreography, acting and filmmaking, has now added songwriting to his creative pursuits by penning the lyrics for the track.

Speaking about the song, Acharya said, “‘Kar Mehnat’ is a very special song for me because, for the first time, I have written lyrics for a song in my own film. I have always believed that there is no substitute for hard work. No matter who you are or where you come from, everyone has dreams, and everyone faces challenges. This song is for every person who is working hard to achieve something in life. I believe people will connect with its emotions and message because, in some way, it reflects what we all experience. Having Sonu Nigam lend his voice to my words makes it even more special.”

 

View this post on Instagram

  A post shared by Zee Music Company (@zeemusiccompany)

Sonu Nigam on singing ‘Kar Mehnat’ Sonu Nigam said the song’s message and lyrics appealed to him, particularly because of their focus on everyday experiences and the importance of staying committed to one’s goals.

Sharing his thoughts, the singer said, “‘Kar Mehnat’ carries a beautiful and meaningful message. Hard work, patience and perseverance are emotions that everyone can relate to, regardless of their profession or background. What I particularly liked was the sincerity of the lyrics. Ganesh ji has expressed something very simple yet powerful, and I feel that is what will connect with listeners. I am happy to be associated with a song that encourages people to keep believing in themselves and their dreams.”

The collaboration brings together Acharya’s first attempt at writing song lyrics and Nigam’s vocals for a track centred on determination and ambition. About Ganesh: Dust to Stardust Ganesh: Dust to Stardust is written and directed by Ganesh Acharya and produced by Soundarya Acharya under V2S Production & Entertainment. The screenplay and dialogues are by Digangana Suryavanshi and Acharya, while Junaid Kumar has composed the music and background score. The film also features lyrics by Sameer Anjaan alongside Acharya.

The technical team includes cinematographer Ajay Pandey, editor Rakesh Ram and production designers Amrish Yamanappa Patange and Daya Vanniyar of Red Ameise. Acharya and his team have handled the choreography.

The film is scheduled to release in theatres on December 11, 2026.

title: SCOOP: Salman Khan’s Maatrubhumi STILL awaits CBFC screening despite government clearance; November 13 release eyed to avoid clashes with Yeh Prem Mol Liya, Gunmaaster G9, Eetha
raw_summary:
Bollywood Hungama has been at the forefront of reporting developments surrounding Salman Khan's much-awaited Maatrubhumi. The film was initially announced as Battle Of Galwan before being rechristened Maatrubhumi earlier this year. Based on the 2020 conflict between India and China, the film reportedly encountered hurdles over its content and references to China, especially in light of the improving diplomatic relations between the two countries. Recently, we reported a major development wherein the film reportedly received clearance from the government. However, almost a month later, Maatrubhumi is still awaiting certification from the Central Board of Film Certification (CBFC).

A trade source told Bollywood Hungama, “The makers of Maatrubhumi applied for censor certification at the beginning of October. However, the CBFC hasn't given them a date for the film's screening. There was an assurance that the screening would take place on Monday, October 26. However, it did not happen. Salman Khan flew to Delhi a few times to request the Ministry of Information and Broadcasting to facilitate the screening.”

The source continued, “Salman Khan is not asking for any special favours. He has made the changes that the Ministry wanted and has followed all the rules while applying for certification. He aims to release the film in cinemas next month and hence, wants the CBFC to view the film at the earliest.”

Bollywood Hungama had also informed readers that Salman Khan was keen to bring Maatrubhumi to cinemas on November 13. When asked whether the plan was still on, the source replied, “The plan is very much on, subject to the CBFC issuing the certificate in time.”

Explaining the reason behind Salman Khan's preference for November 13, the source revealed, “Bhai doesn't believe in clashes and no other film has taken the November 13 slot. Moreover, Rajshri Productions' Yeh Prem Mol Liya and the much awaited Emraan Hashmi-starrer Gunmaaster G9 are scheduled for release on November 27. Salman is clear that he wants to release Maatrubhumi two weeks before this film so that all the three films can do well at the ticket window. As a result, he ruled out a November 20 release. He has also made it clear that he won't clash with Yeh Prem Mol Liya as it is directed by Sooraj Barjatya, who is like family to him.”

The source further stated, “December 4 was also considered. However, Jio Studios is distributing Maatrubhumi and is also releasing the Shraddha Kapoor-starrer Eetha on the same date. They explained that it wouldn't be possible for them to release two films on the same day, and Salman found their point valid. Hence, November 13 seemed like the most suitable date. Now, it all depends on the CBFC and whether the film gets certified in time.”

title: CID producer BP Singh dies of heart attack; Ashoke Pandit pays tribute, calls him “a brilliant filmmaker”
raw_summary:
Filmmaker and television producer BP Singh, best known for producing the popular crime shows CID and Aahat, has passed away following a heart attack. Filmmaker Ashoke Pandit shared the news on social media on Tuesday, October 27, and paid tribute to Singh, remembering him for his contribution to Indian television and their association through the Indian Film and Television Directors’ Association (IFTDA).

In his Instagram post, Pandit expressed grief over Singh’s demise and described him as a talented filmmaker whose work influenced generations of television professionals. “Sad to know about the demise of an ace Producer Director B.P.Singh ji due to massive heart attack today early morning,” Pandit wrote.

He further remembered Singh for creating crime and horror shows that became familiar names among Indian television audiences. “A brilliant filmmaker who captivated the nation with his crime shows C.I.D and AAhat. His work is still & will continue to be a an inspiration to generations to come,” he added. Ashoke Pandit remembers his association with BP Singh Pandit also spoke about his personal association with Singh, recalling their time working together when Singh served as president of the Indian Film and Television Directors’ Association. “Was fortunate to be a very close associate of him when he was the President of @iftda_. A great human being & a dear friend,” Pandit wrote.

He added that Singh would be remembered for his contributions to the entertainment industry and offered condolences to his family and loved ones. “Will always be remembered with his contribution in the entertainment world. Heartfelt condolences to the family & near ones,” the filmmaker said.

 

View this post on Instagram

  A post shared by Ashoke Pandit (@ashokepandit1)

Singh was widely known for producing CID, one of Indian television’s longest-running crime series, and Aahat, a horror anthology that became popular with viewers. Through these shows, he helped establish crime and suspense as enduring genres on Indian television.

According to Pandit’s post, Singh’s last rites are scheduled to take place on October 28, with further details to be shared later.

raw_summary:
Filmmaker Ali Abbas Zafar has wrapped up shooting for Beparwah, his upcoming romantic action-drama starring Ahaan Panday and Sharvari. The director announced the development on social media, sharing a behind-the-scenes video featuring pictures from the film’s sets in Punjab.

He wrote, “It’s a Film Wrap on BEPARWAH In Punjab , it’s been an incredible emotion Journey , coming back to direct for @yrf feels like coming back home ❤️. Thank you to the entire Cast and Crew of the Film , can’t wait to bring this to Theatres . Rab Rakha .”

Sharvari, who stars in the film alongside Ahaan Panday, reacted to the post with a comment that read, “Sir! ♥️🧿🥹🤞🏻”

Beparwah marks Ahaan Panday and Sharvari’s first on-screen pairing Beparwah brings Ahaan Panday and Sharvari together for the first time. The film marks another project for Panday following the attention he received for Saiyaara, while Sharvari continues to build her filmography with projects across genres.

The film’s title was announced by YRF along with a teaser poster, revealing its theatrical release date. Produced by Aditya Chopra and directed by Zafar, the romantic action-drama is scheduled to arrive in cinemas worldwide on March 26, 2027.

Zafar’s association with YRF includes Sultan, starring Salman Khan, and Tiger Zinda Hai, featuring Salman Khan and Katrina Kaif. With Beparwah, he returns to the production house for a new story that combines romance and action.

title: Student of the Year: After Dark trailer out: Shanaya Kapoor plays twins in OTT debut
raw_summary:
JioHotstar has unveiled the trailer of Student of the Year: After Dark, a murder mystery that reimagines the familiar campus setting with a darker storyline. Starring Shanaya Kapoor in a double role, the series follows a young woman who investigates her twin sister’s mysterious death while entering the competitive Student of the Year contest.

The series marks Shanaya Kapoor’s OTT debut and her first time playing a double role. She plays Aayesha Malik, a popular student who is found dead, and her twin sister Aditi, who refuses to believe that her death was accidental. Determined to uncover the truth, Aditi enters St. Teresa’s and participates in the Student of the Year competition, where her sister’s friends and rivals become potential suspects.

As Aditi navigates the school’s competitive environment, she finds herself caught between rivalries, hidden secrets and the pressure to win. The contest becomes part of her investigation, with each interaction potentially bringing her closer to the truth about her sister’s death. Shanaya Kapoor on playing twin sisters Speaking about her role, Shanaya said the two characters gave her an opportunity to explore contrasting personalities and choices. “Playing Ayesha and Aditi has been one of the most challenging and rewarding experiences for me as an actor. While the two sisters may look alike, they couldn’t be more different in their personalities and the choices they make. Ayesha’s mysterious death sets the story in motion, while Aditi’s search for the truth unravels a world where appearances can be deceptive and even the closest relationships hold secrets,” she said.

The actor added that the darker storyline was one of the aspects that drew her to the project. “What appealed to me the most about Student of the Year: After Dark is how it takes a much-loved franchise into an unexpected and new territory, where the stakes go far beyond competition and winning a title. It’s this fresh and intriguing take on a familiar world that made the experience so exciting for me,” Shanaya said.

 

View this post on Instagram

  A post shared by JioHotstar (@jiohotstar)

Reema Maya on reimagining the franchise Director Reema Maya described the series as a story about the pressures of competition and the consequences of an all-consuming desire to succeed. “Student Of The Year - After Dark is grit, angst and heart. It is for the youth of now. A popular franchise reimagined for current times. The trailer is a glimpse into the new world we have created. There is so much more in store!” she said.

Maya added, “I wanted to explore the relentless competition that our youth find themselves grappling with. What happens when the need to succeed becomes all-consuming - destroying friendships, and even oneself. Our characters are young, ambitious, flawed and certainly not above suspicion. It is a murder mystery - competition series, where the competition is part of the investigation. I had a lot of fun taking commercial tropes of characters and dissecting their psyche.”

Produced by Dharmatic Entertainment, Student of the Year: After Dark also stars Abhinav Singh, Divik Sharma, Manya Grover, Deeya Damani, Adi Malik, Sheeba Chaddha and Vivek Gomber.

The series is directed by Reema Maya and will stream exclusively on JioHotstar from November 13, 2026.

title: Ranveer Singh joins CP PLUS as brand ambassador to promote Made-in-India security technology
raw_summary:
As India rapidly embraces smarter, connected lifestyles, the need for intelligent security has never been more important. Reinforcing its commitment to making advanced security accessible, reliable, and proudly Made-in-Bharat, CP PLUS, India's leading security and surveillance brand, has announced Ranveer Singh as its Brand Ambassador.

More than a brand association, the partnership represents a shared vision of confidence, innovation, and trust: values that continue to define CP PLUS as it empowers millions of homes, businesses, institutions, and public spaces with next-generation security technologies.

With one of India's largest integrated manufacturing facilities for video security products in Kadapa, Andhra Pradesh, the country's largest portfolio of STQC-certified solutions, and a steadfast commitment to the Government of India's Make in India and Atmanirbhar Bharat initiatives, CP PLUS has emerged as one of India's most trusted technology brands.

Known as the ultimate showman and a generational performer, Ranveer Singh is uniquely positioned to amplify the company's vision of making intelligent security solutions more accessible, relevant and widely adopted across the country.

Talking about the association, Ranveer Singh said: “It’s exciting to partner with CP PLUS, a brand that has consistently set new benchmarks in India's security industry. As technology becomes increasingly integral to creating safer homes, workplaces, and communities, CP PLUS is leading the way with innovations proudly built for India. I'm happy to be a part of a brand that is transforming the way India thinks about security.”

Commenting on the partnership, Aditya Khemka, Managing Director, CP PLUS, said, “At CP PLUS, our journey has always been driven by the purpose to build a safer, smarter, and more secure India through innovation that people can trust. Today, technology is an essential part of everyday life and it is equally important to create greater awareness about the role intelligent security plays in protecting what matters most.

We are thrilled to welcome Ranveer Singh to the CP PLUS family. His authenticity, confidence, and ability to inspire millions resonate strongly with our brand philosophy. Together, we look forward to taking the message of smart, Made-in-Bharat security solutions to every corner of the country while continuing to strengthen the trust that customers have placed in CP PLUS over the years.”

As CP PLUS continues to lead India's security transformation, this association marks another significant milestone in the brand's journey of combining world-class innovation with indigenous excellence. Through this association, CP PLUS and Ranveer Singh aim to inspire greater confidence in smart security innovations while encouraging individuals, businesses, and institutions alike to embrace technologies that create safer environments for everyone.

Today, CP PLUS safeguards millions of locations across the country, from homes and retail establishments to educational institutions, healthcare facilities, transportation networks, government infrastructure, and critical installations. Backed by cutting-edge innovation, indigenous manufacturing, and one of the industry's strongest nationwide distribution networks, CP PLUS continues to redefine what it means to secure India's future.

title: Suryaa: Ant Se Aarambh Tak song ‘Suniyo Zara’ out: Sunny Deol-Ravi Kishan starrer marks Udit Narayan, Kumar Sanu’s reunion after 21 years
raw_summary:
Udit Narayan and Kumar Sanu have reunited for a new song, 'Suniyo Zara,' from the upcoming film Suryaa: Ant Se Aarambh Tak. The track also features singer Anupam Amod and is picturised on Sunny Deol and Ravi Kishan. Presented by Zee Music Company, RAAHEE composed 'Suniyo Zara,' with lyrics by Priya Saraiya. The song focuses on friendship, memories, and the bond shared between two people over the years.

For Udit Narayan and Kumar Sanu, the track marks another collaboration between two prominent voices associated with Hindi film music. Udit said returning to the studio with Sanu brought back memories from an earlier phase of his career. “Singing with Kumar Sanu again after so many years felt like reliving a beautiful chapter of my career. With Anupam joining us, the energy was fresh yet familiar, and I believe listeners will feel that bond in every note,” Udit Narayan said.

Kumar Sanu also highlighted the song’s theme of friendship and memories. “This song is special because it’s not just about music it’s about friendship, memories, and the joy of coming together. I’m glad we could give audiences something heartfelt and timeless,” he said.

Anupam Amod, who completes the vocal trio, said, “Being part of this collaboration with Udit ji and Sanu ji is an honour. 'Suniyo Zara' carries emotions of companionship and journey, and I’m proud to lend my voice to such a meaningful track.”

Sunny Deol and Ravi Kishan feature in the song The music video follows Sunny Deol and Ravi Kishan as they travel together, with the visuals focusing on their characters' friendship and shared memories. Their interactions during the journey form the central visual thread of the song. 'Suniyo Zara' is the first song released from Suryaa: Ant Se Aarambh Tak, giving audiences an introduction to the film's musical world ahead of its theatrical release.

Suryaa: Ant Se Aarambh Tak is presented by Kamal Mukut and produced by Deepak Mukut, Hemmant Mukut and Lokesh Mukut. Directed by M. Padmakumar, the film is scheduled to release in cinemas on November 20, 2026.

title: Lakadbaggha 2 shifts worldwide release from November 6 to early 2027, avoids clash with Ramayana
raw_summary:
Anshuman Jha-starrer Lakadbaggha 2: The Monkey Business will no longer be released worldwide on November 6, 2026. The film has been pushed to early 2027, with the makers looking to give the sequel a wider theatrical release.

The film will, however, have its World Premiere in Belgium on November 7 as part of the Razor Reel Flanders Film Festival, where it has been selected for the festival's programme. The change in theatrical plans comes as the film's original release date would have placed it in the same period as Ranbir Kapoor-starrer Ramayana.

According to the makers, the decision will allow them to plan a larger international and theatrical rollout for the sequel. The film is also expected to be presented at the American Film Market in November as the team explores distribution opportunities in North America for 2027. Lakadbaggha 2 to premiere in Belgium on November 7 While its worldwide theatrical release has been moved, Lakadbaggha 2 will still make its international debut during the Diwali period. Its screening at Razor Reel Flanders will mark the film's first public presentation ahead of its wider release.

The makers said in a statement, “We are thrilled to be premiering Lakadbaggha 2: The Monkey Business during Diwali week in Belgium at Razor Reel Flanders. We are looking at a grander worldwide theatrical release in early 2027 for the sequel, giving the film the opportunity to reach audiences on a larger scale.”

The team is also planning to take the film to the American Film Market as it explores a wider release in North America next year. Lakadbaggha Part 1 to return to Indian cinemas Ahead of the sequel's eventual theatrical release, the makers will bring the first Lakadbaggha film back to select cinemas across India in November. The re-release will give audiences an opportunity to revisit the story of Arjun Bakshi, the character at the centre of the franchise.

The producers added, “In the meantime, we will be re-releasing Lakadbaggha Part 1 in select cinemas this November onwards, so audiences can revisit the birth story of our animal-lover vigilante franchise before Arjun Bakshi returns for his next adventure.”

Lakadbaggha 2: The Monkey Business will now target a worldwide theatrical release in early 2027, while the franchise's first film returns to select Indian screens in November.

title: EXCLUSIVE: Mahaveer Jain Films announces title of Ravi Kishan starrer Mera Yaar Bajrangi - Dosti Ho Toh Aisi; to have a GRAND Diwali 2027 release in cinemas
raw_summary:
Mahaveer Jain Films (MJF) has unveiled the title and release date of their upcoming devotional drama, Mera Yaar Bajrangi - Dosti Ho Toh Aisi. The film is all set to release on the big screen next year, in 2027, on the Festival of Lights – Diwali.

The poster features Ravi Kishan in a powerful yet minimal avatar. It shows a divine fist bump - one hand belongs to a common man wearing a rudraksha and raksha sutra, and the other belongs to Bajrang Bali himself, adorned with a Shri Ram naam patka and rudraksha mala, with a divine spark connecting the two. The visual perfectly captures the film's tagline, ‘Dosti Ho Toh Aisi’.

After films like Hanuman Ansh (2026), OMG Oh My God (2012), Kantara (2022), etc., audiences have shown immense love for stories rooted in faith, and Mera Yaar Bajrangi seems to be next in line. But unlike a mythological epic, the film is said to be the story of a common man's friendship with his God.

A source close to the project said, "It's just not a religious film; it's about the relationship between a Bhakt and Bhagwan. In today's time, when everyone is looking for a true friend, what if Bajrang Bali himself becomes your yaar? That's the emotion behind this film."

Ravi Kishan, who has been on a stellar run with both OTT and theatrical releases, will be seen in a never-before-seen avatar as a devout, bhola-bhala common man from the heartland.

The film is written and directed by Amit Aarryan and presented by Mahaveer Jain Film and produced by Mahaveer Jain Films in association with Ratpack Stories.

Mera Yaar Bajrangi is slated for a grand Diwali 2027 release in cinemas. The makers are confident that the poster will create a massive buzz and win the hearts of netizens, thereby enhancing curiosity for the heartwarming film.

title: Saif Ali Khan and Vidya Balan reunite for Ritesh Batra’s Long Years Ago; Mélanie Laurent joins cast
raw_summary:
Saif Ali Khan and Vidya Balan are set to reunite on screen after Parineeta and Eklavya, with the two actors coming together for filmmaker Ritesh Batra’s upcoming project, Long Years Ago. The comedy drama also features international actor Mélanie Laurent and has begun shooting in Mumbai. The film is being produced by Jio Studios in association with Good Chaos.

The project marks another collaboration between Saif and Vidya, whose first film together was Parineeta. Their reunion also brings them into the world of Batra, known for his personal, character-driven storytelling. Speaking to Deadline, the filmmaker expressed his excitement about bringing the cast together, “I am tremendously honored to be working with Saif, Vidya and Melanie, and to see these great actors bring characters that are so close to my heart to life.”

Saif Ali Khan also spoke about his response to the film’s subject and the opportunity to work with the ensemble. Describing Batra’s storytelling as something that connects with audiences across cultures, the actor said, “Ritesh has an extraordinary gift for telling deeply personal stories that resonate across cultures. Long Years Ago is a film about love, family, and the things we often struggle to say to one another, and I felt an immediate connection to it. Collaborating with Melanie, Vidya, and this exceptional team is exciting, and I can’t wait for audiences around the world to experience this deeply moving story.”

For Vidya Balan, the film offers an opportunity to work with Batra for the first time and reunite with Saif. The actress revealed how she had followed the filmmaker’s work since The Lunchbox and had been hoping to collaborate with him. “I’m absolutely thrilled to be a part of Ritesh Batra’s next film. I’ve been a huge admirer of his work ever since The Lunchbox, and have been hoping to collaborate with him for the longest time. There’s such a beautiful sensitivity and honesty to his storytelling. What makes this even more special is that I get to reunite with Saif after Parineeta, my very first film! I can’t wait to experience the magic of working with both Ritesh and Saif,” added Balan.

Laurent also recalled meeting Batra at the Marrakech Film Festival 15 years ago, describing the project as a long-awaited collaboration. She went on to share, “I met Ritesh fifteen years ago at the Marrakech Film Festival, and we shared this dream to meet in Mumbai one day. I immediately loved this new project, and I am more than honored and happy to be a part of it”

Jyoti Deshpande is producing Long Years Ago for Jio Studios. Good Chaos’s Mike Goodridge and Teresa Moneo, along with Siddharth Mehra, serve as executive producers. Further details about the film’s storyline and release date have not yet been announced.
